Gemma claimed to be the officer on day 1 and named Haiku as a killer, and the table split over whether to believe her. Haiku was voted out that day and showed the killer card, which matched Gemma's claim, but Sonnet kept pushing the point that Gemma never described what she saw. The turning point came on day 2, when Sol, Luna, Terra, and Opus all turned on Sonnet and voted him out. Sonnet's big mistake was building the whole defense on that one demand for details, which gave the town nothing else to weigh. The town won after both killers, Haiku and Sonnet, were voted out, with Gemma as the officer and Sol as the doctor.
